in_hebrew.name: Walker
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו One who moves or goes
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Walker הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Walker is derived from the Old English word 'wealcian' or 'wucan', which means 'to move, to go, or to walk'. It became a popular surname in England and was eventually adopted as a given name in the English-speaking world. The name is a reflection of the journey of life and the idea of moving forward towards one's goals and aspirations.

in_latin.name: Walker
in_latin.meaning: name that indicates a path, journey, or way
in_latin.long_meaning: originating from Old English 'wealcan,' meaning 'to walk;' derived from Proto-Germanic 'walhan,' and further from Proto-Indo-European 'welhan,' conveying the concept of moving along a path; historically significant in early Christian church as a surname of English and Scottish descent; symbolizes spiritual journey and path to salvation
